en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town along a river. A masonry and metal bridge crosses the river in the foreground. On the right bank are rows of trees, modest multi‑story houses and civic buildings, and an open grassy area with laundry hanging on lines. In the background rise several church towers and spires dominating the skyline, and low wooded hills beyond the town. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.
